name: @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-wallet
description: Browser wallet identity, signed capabilities, and peer connections for AI agents

scripts.test:types: npx -p typescript@5 tsc --noEmit --strict --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom tests/types-fixture/consumer.ts
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm test --prefix packages/runtime && npm test --prefix packages/mcp && npm test --prefix packages/agent
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/e2e.test.mjs && node scripts/test-browser-e2e.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "packages/p2p/*.{js,d.ts}" "packages/runtime/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/runtime/README.md packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md "packages/mcp/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" "packages/agent/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/agent/README.md "scripts/*.mjs" "scripts/e2e/*.mjs" "tests/*.mjs" "docs/*.md" README.md CHANGELOG.md index.html landing.css styles.css "src/landing/**/*.{js,jsx}" apps/p2p/app.js package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/p2p/*.{js,d.ts}" "packages/runtime/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/runtime/README.md packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md "packages/mcp/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" "packages/agent/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/agent/README.md "scripts/*.mjs" "scripts/e2e/*.mjs" "tests/*.mjs" "docs/*.md" README.md CHANGELOG.md index.html landing.css styles.css "src/landing/**/*.{js,jsx}" apps/p2p/app.js package.json
